name: OFF LIMITS
source:
Original digital novel.
Haruka is a girl suddenly appeared before the protagonist of this story Satoshi.
She said she came from outer space by a space ship.

Ayame, a girl who also came to the earth, has been waiting for a chance to kill Haruka in order to prevent her attempt that she thwarts SPR project which will soon take place on the earth. What is SPR project?

A heartbreaking love story!! Includes 3D CG pictures and a vocal theme song.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ030723.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
原创数字小说。

Haruka突然出现在故事主人公Satoshi面前。

她说自己乘坐宇宙飞船从外太空而来。

Ayame也来到了地球。为了阻止Haruka妨碍即将在地球启动的SPR计划，她一直伺机杀死Haruka。SPR计划究竟是什么？

一段令人心碎的爱情故事！包含3D CG图片和主题歌曲。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ030723.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
